title: Your reputation, as good as your work
about: The hero video's narration, one line per entry. tools/voice.py reads it to make the voiceover, tools/render.mjs to time the scenes and write the captions. Claim rules (GTM brain, Phase 3 and 6): no promised reviews, ratings, rankings, calls or jobs; every statistic carries its source on screen; never blame staff; the same honest ask to every customer; no em dashes. voice.say respells words for the voice only (Rempo is said REM-po); the captions keep the text as written.

lines.text: Your crew does great work.
Furnaces fixed the same day. Leaks found on the first visit. Customers who'd recommend you to anyone.
But a happy customer is a quiet one.
They mean to leave a review. Then dinner happens, the kids happen, life happens.
And by then, everyone at the shop is on to the next call.
Tonight, a homeowner across town finds water on her basement floor.
She grabs her phone and searches for a plumber.
Your shop has the better rating. But your newest review is five months old, with no reply.
The shop down the road got one two days ago, and answered every review.
She calls them.
Three out of four people look for reviews from the last three months.
lines.source: 74% look for reviews from the last three months. BrightLocal Local Consumer Review Survey 2026

lines.text: And four in five lean toward a business that replies to all its reviews.
lines.source: 80% are more likely to use a business that replies to all its reviews. BrightLocal Local Consumer Review Survey 2026

lines.text: So every great job that never becomes a review is proof you earned, and never got to use.
You did the better work. They just had the proof.
Rempo runs your Google reviews for you.
We connect to the software you already log jobs in.
When a job is marked complete, your customer gets a thank-you with your crew's photo and their first name. Then one reminder.
Every review gets a reply, written for that review.
The same honest ask to every customer, and you never have to run it.
Every customer asked. Every review answered.
So the next time someone searches at nine at night, they see what your customers already know.
Rempo. Your reputation, as good as your work.
